name: Scape Guildford
address: 1 Kernel Court, Guildford GU1 4BJ, United Kingdom
about:
Scape Guildford is a modern student accommodation in Guildford, located at 1 Kernel Court, GU1 4BJ, just a 5-minute walk from the University of Surrey. It offers fully furnished studios, en-suite rooms, and 2-bedroom apartments, all with inclusive bills for hassle-free living. Rooms include a spacious study area and a large wardrobe for ample storage. For added peace of mind, the building is supported by CCTV, on-site security, and a 24/7 reception. Located close to the University of Surrey and ACM campuses, the property offers easy access to student life. Guildford railway station is just a 10-minute walk away, with supermarkets and restaurants nearby, making Scape student accommodation Guildford a convenient choice for students.Rooms in Scape Guildford

All rooms feature en suite facilities, comfortable double beds, desks, and ample storage space, ensuring a seamless check-in experience.The Studios: Brand new and fully furnished, with core furniture including a mattress, desk, and chair, and built-in storage. Each Studio comes with a private kitchenette, including a fridge/freezer, microwave, combi oven, and hob, providing a fully independent cooking space. Bedding and kitchen equipment, such as pots and pans, are not provided.En-suite: Fully furnished with core furniture including a mattress, desk, and chair, and built-in storage. Each En-suite room comes with its own private bathroom, while kitchen appliances are provided in the shared kitchen and dining area. Students will need to bring their own bedding and kitchen equipment, such as pots and pans.2-bedroom Apartment: Fully furnished with core furniture including a mattress, desk, and chair, and built-in storage. Each apartment features private bedrooms with under-bed storage and fitted double wardrobes, while bathrooms and the kitchen are shared. The kitchen comes with built-in appliances, including a fridge, freezer, microwave, combi oven, and hob, and a breakfast bar with stools provides space for socializing.Amenities in Scape Guildford
Scape accommodation Guildford takes pride in its well-equipped community spaces.
